_comment: Single source for every account and calendar constant the builders use.
Loaded by tools/account_config.py. Numbers that feed Decimal arithmetic are strings so json floats never touch them.
THIS FILE SHIPS WITH SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE VALUES for a made-up company (Acme Software).
Run the account-setup skill to replace every value with your own account facts before a live run.
Drift guards: test_account_config.py asserts the stated figures here match budget-plan.md. Update both together.
Stated budgets are READ from the owner's figures, never derived (campaign-guardrails rule 8). A month with no stated Google Ads split stays null with its reason.

campaign_buckets._comment: IDs, never names: a word like 'Brand' in a name can also match non-brand campaigns. Synthetic example IDs.

budgets.fx_note: flat example rate; set your own in account-setup
budgets.no_split_reason: no stated Google Ads split for this month in budget-plan.md. Ask the account owner. Never derive it from a share of the all-channel total, and never carry another month's figure forward (campaign-guardrails rule 8)

2026-08.source: budget-plan.md, 'Google Ads budget' table: the owner's stated figure

planned_step_down.note: the PLANNED month-over-month budget step down. The plan, never a finding (campaign-guardrails rule 8).

elasticity_bands.name: band_3
elasticity_bands.note: above USD 20,000/month no data exists - do not recommend

budgets.elasticity_scope: monthly Google Ads budget increase, account-wide, from budget-plan.md

cac_anchor.source: budget-plan.md, CAC table: real customers and real free trials
